subject: maths
title: Turns: Quarter, Half, Three-Quarter and Full Turns, Clockwise and Anticlockwise
seo_title: Year 2 Turns Worksheets: Quarter, Half and Full Turns, Clockwise and Anticlockwise (Free, Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify, describe and demonstrate quarter, half, three-quarter and full measures of turn in everyday situations
meta_desc: Free Year 2 maths worksheets on turns: quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns, clockwise and anticlockwise, what you face after a turn, turning shapes and turns in everyday life. 100 questions with pictures and an answer key, following the Australian Curriculum (AC9M2M05).
key_big: A turn tells how far something goes round: a quarter, a half, three quarters or all the way.
key_sub: 2 quarter turns make a half turn and 4 make a full turn. Clockwise is the way clock hands go; anticlockwise is the opposite way. A half turn makes you face the opposite way, and a full turn brings you back to the start.
body_html:
What is a turn?

When something turns, it goes round. We say how far it goes round.

TurnHow far roundQuarter turns
Quarter turna quarter of the way1
Half turnhalfway (face the opposite way)2
Three-quarter turnthree quarters of the way3
Full turnall the way (back to the start)4

Clockwise and anticlockwise

Clockwise is the way clock hands go. Anticlockwise is the opposite way.

What do you face after a turn?

Example

Mia faces the board. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does she face now?

Go the way clock hands go, one quarter: board, then window.

Answer: the window

Example

Jack faces the board. He makes a half turn. What does he face now?

A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The door is opposite the board.

Answer: the door

Turning shapes

A turned shape is the same shape. Only the way it faces changes.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up clockwise and anticlockwiseClockwise is the way clock hands go: from 12 to 3
Calling a three-quarter turn a quarter turnFollow the arrow all the way, not just the end
Calling a half turn a quarter turnAfter a half turn you face the opposite way
Thinking a turned shape is a new shapeTurning only changes the way a shape faces

faq.q: What is AC9M2M05 in the Australian Curriculum?
faq.a: It is the Year 2 maths content description “identify, describe and demonstrate quarter, half, three-quarter and full measures of turn in everyday situations”. Students turn their bodies, objects and shapes and describe the turn.

faq.q: How do you teach clockwise and anticlockwise to a Year 2 child?
faq.a: Show an analog clock: clockwise is the way the hands go, from 12 to 3. Anticlockwise is the opposite way. Let your child turn their body both ways and say the turn out loud.

faq.q: Do Year 2 students learn right angles?
faq.a: Not yet. In Year 2 students describe turns as quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns. In Year 3 they learn that a quarter turn makes a right angle.

faq.q: What are some everyday examples of turns for Year 2?
faq.a: Clock hands, taps, jar lids, keys, door knobs, a merry-go-round and a skateboard all turn. A half turn on a skateboard sends you back the way you came, and a full turn of a merry-go-round brings you back to the start.

sets.title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns

items.q: How many quarter turns make a three-quarter turn?
items.e: Three quarters means 3 quarter turns.
The arrow goes all the way round, back to the dashed line. That is a full turn.

items.q: Which is the smallest turn?
items.e: A quarter turn is only 1 quarter of the way round. It is the smallest.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round. That is a three-quarter turn.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a full turn?
items.e: 4 quarters make a whole. So 4 quarter turns make a full turn.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes halfway round. The end line points the opposite way. That is a half turn.

items.q: Which turn takes you back to the start?
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round. You face the same way again.

items.q: Noah makes a half turn. Then he makes a quarter turn the same way. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 2 quarters + 1 quarter = 3 quarters. That is a three-quarter turn.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a half turn?
items.e: A quarter and another quarter make a half. So 2 quarter turns make a half turn.
The arrow goes all the way round, back to the dashed line. That is a full turn.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. That is a quarter turn.

items.q: Which turn makes you face the opposite way?
items.e: A half turn goes halfway round. You face the opposite way.

items.q: Sienna makes a half turn. Then she makes another half turn the same way. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: A half + a half = a whole. That is a full turn.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round. That is a three-quarter turn.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes halfway round. The end line points the opposite way. That is a half turn.

items.q: How many half turns make a full turn?
items.e: A half and another half make a whole. So 2 half turns make a full turn.

items.q: Grace says this arrow shows a quarter turn. Is she right?
c: No, it is a half turn
Yes, it is a quarter turn
No, it is a three-quarter turn
No, it is a full turn
items.e: The end line points the opposite way to the dashed line. The arrow goes halfway round: a half turn.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. That is a quarter turn.

c: Yes, it is a quarter turn
No, it is a full turn
No, it is a three-quarter turn
No, it is a half turn
items.e: Follow the arrow, not just the end line. It goes 3 quarters of the way round: a three-quarter turn.

items.q: Aarav makes a quarter turn. Then he makes another quarter turn the same way. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = 2 quarters. That is a half turn.

items.q: Mei makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then she makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which way does she face now?
c: a quarter turn anticlockwise from the start
a quarter turn clockwise from the start
the same way as at the start
items.e: The second turn goes back the other way by the same amount. So she faces the same way as at the start.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round. It goes the same way as clock hands: clockwise.

items.q: Which way do the hands on a clock turn?
items.e: Clock hands always turn the same way. That way is called clockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 12 back to 9 is a quarter of the way round, the opposite way to clocks: anticlockwise.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. It goes the same way as clock hands: clockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 12 to 6 is halfway round, the same way clocks go: clockwise.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round. It goes the opposite way to clock hands: anticlockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 3 back to 9 is halfway round, the opposite way to clocks: anticlockwise.

c: Yes, it is a quarter turn anticlockwise
No, it is a half turn clockwise
No, it is a three-quarter turn clockwise
No, it is a quarter turn clockwise
items.e: Follow the arrow all the way. It goes 3 quarters of the way round, the same way as clock hands.

items.q: Kai makes a half turn clockwise. His friend makes a half turn anticlockwise. They both started facing the board. What is true now?
c: They both face away from the board
items.e: A half turn either way makes you face the opposite way. So they both face away from the board.

items.q: Which turn ends in the same place as a quarter turn clockwise?
items.e: 1 quarter one way ends where 3 quarters the other way ends. 1 + 3 = 4 quarters: a full turn.

items.q: Ava makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then she makes another quarter turn clockwise. How far has she turned?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = a half. Both turns were clockwise, so it is a half turn clockwise.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. It goes the same way as clock hands: clockwise.

items.q: What does anticlockwise mean?
c: the opposite way to clock hands
the same way as clock hands
items.e: Anticlockwise is the opposite way to the way clock hands go.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. It goes the opposite way to clock hands: anticlockwise.

items.q: Zara says this arrow turns clockwise. Is she right?
c: No, it is a half turn
items.e: Clock hands go from 12 to 3: to the right at the top. This arrow goes to the left at the top. It is anticlockwise.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes halfway round. It goes the same way as clock hands: clockwise.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes halfway round. It goes the opposite way to clock hands: anticlockwise.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. It goes the opposite way to clock hands: anticlockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 12 to 3 is a quarter of the way round, the same way clocks go: clockwise.

sets.title: What do you face after a turn?

items.q: Oliver faces the shed. He makes a three-quarter turn clockwise. What does he face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: shed, then gate, then tree, then house.

items.q: The hand points to 12. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 12, then 3.

items.q: Amelia faces the door. She makes a half turn. She says she faces the window. Is she right?
items.e: The window is only a quarter turn away. A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The board is opposite the door.

items.q: Leo faces the shed. He makes a half turn. What does he face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The tree is opposite the shed.

items.q: Charlotte faces the swings. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: swings, then canteen.

items.q: Ruby faces the slide. She makes a three-quarter turn anticlockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the opposite way to clock hands, one quarter at a time: slide, then sandpit, then canteen, then swings.

items.q: The hand points to 6. It makes a half turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 6, then 9, then 12.

items.q: Jack faces the desk. He makes a full turn. What does he face now?
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round. He faces the desk again.

items.q: Harper faces the board. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: board, then window.

items.q: The hand points to 12. It makes a three-quarter turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 12, then 3, then 6, then 9.

items.q: Ethan faces the sandpit. He makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does he face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: sandpit, then slide.

items.q: The hand points to 3. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 3, then 6.

items.q: William faces the window. He makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. What does he face now?
items.e: Go the opposite way to clock hands, one quarter at a time: window, then board.

items.q: Matilda faces the door. She makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the opposite way to clock hands, one quarter at a time: door, then window.

items.q: An arrow points up. It makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which picture shows it now?
items.e: Picture D. A quarter turn anticlockwise turns the arrow from up to the left.

items.q: Isla faces the house. She makes a half turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The gate is opposite the house.

items.q: An arrow points up. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which picture shows it now?
items.e: Picture B. A quarter turn clockwise turns the arrow from up to the right.

items.q: You make a full turn. What do you face now?
c: the same thing as at the start
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round. You end up facing the same way as at the start.

items.q: An arrow points up. It makes a half turn. Which picture shows it now?
items.e: Picture C. A half turn makes the arrow point the opposite way: down.

items.q: Mia faces the gate. She makes a three-quarter turn clockwise. Her friend makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. What is true now?
items.e: 3 quarters clockwise ends in the same place as 1 quarter anticlockwise. So they face the same way.

items.q: Turn the start shape a quarter turn clockwise. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture A. The top of the shape turns to the right, the way clock hands go. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The flag pole pointed up. Now it points left. That is a quarter turn anticlockwise.

items.q: Lachlan turns a puzzle piece a half turn. Then he turns it another half turn. What does it look like now?
c: the same as at the start
items.e: A half turn and another half turn make a full turn. The piece is back the way it started.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The shape is upside down now. That is a half turn.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The top of the flag pole turns to the right, the way clock hands go: a quarter turn clockwise.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The shape looks the same as before. It went all the way round: a full turn.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The arrow pointed up. Now it points right. That is a quarter turn clockwise.

items.q: Turn the start shape a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture C. The top of the shape turns to the left, the opposite way to clock hands. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: When you turn a shape, what changes?
items.e: Turning does not change the shape or its size. Only the way it faces changes.

items.q: Turn the start shape a quarter turn clockwise. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture B. The top of the shape turns to the right, the way clock hands go. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The top of the shape turns to the left, the opposite way to clock hands: a quarter turn anticlockwise.

items.q: Which shape looks different after a quarter turn?
items.e: A long rectangle that lies flat stands up tall after a quarter turn. The others look the same.

items.q: Which capital letter looks the same after a half turn?
items.e: Turn the page upside down. S still looks like S. J, P and R do not.

items.q: A square makes a quarter turn. What does it look like now?
items.e: All the sides of a square are the same. After a quarter turn it looks just the same.

items.q: A flag pole points up. Liam turns the flag a quarter turn clockwise. He says the pole points left now. Is he right?
items.e: Clockwise is the way clock hands go. From 12 they go to 3, on the right. So the pole points right.

items.q: A triangle has 3 corners. It makes a half turn. How many corners does it have now?
items.e: Turning a shape does not change it. It still has 3 corners.

items.q: Turn the start shape a half turn. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture B. After a half turn the shape is upside down. The top is now at the bottom. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: Which capital letter looks the same after a half turn?
items.e: Turn the page upside down. N still looks like N. L, F and E do not.

items.q: Turn the start shape a half turn. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture D. After a half turn the shape is upside down. The top is now at the bottom. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: Turn the start shape a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture C. The top of the shape turns to the left, the opposite way to clock hands. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: How long does the minute hand take to make a full turn?
items.e: The minute hand goes all the way round the clock in 60 minutes. That is 1 hour.

items.q: Harper turns the music up. The knob makes a three-quarter turn clockwise. How many quarter turns is that?
items.e: A three-quarter turn is 3 quarter turns.

items.q: Aarav turns the garden tap a quarter turn. Then he turns it another quarter turn the same way. How far has the tap turned?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = 2 quarters. That is a half turn.

items.q: Charlotte opens a jar. She turns the lid a quarter turn. Then she turns it 2 more quarter turns. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 1 quarter + 2 quarters = 3 quarters. That is a three-quarter turn.

items.q: Noah rides his skateboard to the end of the path. He does a half turn. Which way does he go now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. So he rides back the way he came.

items.q: Grace spins on her skateboard and makes a full turn. Which way does she face now?
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round, so she faces the same way as before.

items.q: It was 7 o’clock. The minute hand made this turn. What time is it now?
items.e: A half turn of the minute hand is 30 minutes. 30 minutes after 7 o’clock is half past 7.

items.q: Matilda turns a round door knob a quarter turn clockwise. She lets go and it turns back. How does it turn back?
items.e: It goes back the same amount the other way. The other way to clockwise is anticlockwise.

items.q: It was 4 o’clock. The minute hand made this turn. What time is it now?
items.e: A quarter turn of the minute hand is 15 minutes. 15 minutes after 4 o’clock is quarter past 4.

items.q: Kai faces the sea. He turns to face the car park behind him. What turn is that?
items.e: The car park is opposite the sea. Turning to face the opposite way is a half turn.

items.q: A bike wheel makes a full turn and then a half turn. How many quarter turns is that?
items.e: A full turn is 4 quarter turns. A half turn is 2 more. 4 + 2 = 6.

items.q: Chloe gets on the Ferris wheel at the bottom. The wheel makes a half turn. Where is her seat now?
items.e: A half turn goes halfway round the wheel. The bottom goes to the top.

items.q: From 2 o’clock to half past 2, what turn does the minute hand make?
items.e: The minute hand goes from 12 to 6. That is halfway round: a half turn.

items.q: You turn a jar lid anticlockwise to open it. Which way do you turn it to close it?
items.e: Closing is the opposite of opening. The opposite of anticlockwise is clockwise.

items.q: In netball, Zara catches the ball facing the goal. She pivots a half turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. So she faces away from the goal.

items.q: At the school concert, Ava does 4 quarter turns the same way. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 4 quarters make a whole. That is a full turn.

items.q: Sienna puts a key in the front door lock. She turns it a half turn. How does the key look now?
items.e: A half turn turns the key upside down. A quarter turn would leave it on its side.

items.q: At lunch, Mei faces the canteen. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go: canteen, then sandpit.

items.q: The biggest slice of pizza points at Isla. She turns the plate a half turn. Who does the slice point at now?
items.e: A half turn makes the slice point the opposite way: across the table.

items.q: Cooper rides the merry-go-round. It makes 1 full turn and stops. Where is he now?
c: a quarter of the way round
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round, back to the start.
